game.name: 227 AI
game.desc: 227 AI is a private, offline language model that runs entirely on the R36S. Ask questions, talk with the on-screen keyboard, hear replies read aloud, and dictate with the microphone. No internet, no cloud, no accounts.

game.name: MIC TEST
game.desc: Record a few seconds from each audio capture card, play it back and compare speech quality. Use it to find the microphone the R36S hears best.
